name: Megaton's Fate
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Disarm — Destroy target artifact. Create four Treasure tokens.
• Detonate — Megaton's Fate deals 8 damage to each creature. Each player gets four rad counters.
blocked_sentences: • Detonate — Megaton's Fate deals 8 damage to each creature. Each player gets four rad counters.

needs.what: rad as a player counter kind (a PlayerState field plus an entry in the player counter kinds, with the rule-725 rad trigger at the beginning of each player's precombat main phase: mill that many cards, lose 1 life and remove one rad counter per nonland card milled), and an op that gives a player N rad counters (e.g. an `add_rad` op shaped like add_poison/add_energy with `amount` and `player`, here run over each player via for_each_player)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_poison and add_energy are the only ops that put counters on a player and each is fixed to its own kind; add_counters acts on objects, not players; double_player_counters and lose_all_player_counters only modify existing kinds; no rad counter kind or rad precombat-main trigger exists in the engine
